top_signals.title: The Goldilocks Fallacy: The Undefined Limits of Korea’s Nuclear Role
top_signals.summary:
“Unthreatening and respectful.” That is how the president of the United States described North Korea on Aug. 16, 2026, in his social media post ordering his secretary of defense to scale back joint exercises with South Korea.
